observations: Photo 0 shows the front of a solar panel with a white frame and a grid of dark cells.
Photo 1 shows the same panel from a slightly different angle, with a watermark for 'NETWORK SOLAR VENTURES'.
Photo 2 shows the back of the panel, which is white and has three black cable lugs.
Photo 3 shows the back of the panel with a small label in the center.
The panel is shown leaning against a wooden support in a cluttered indoor or semi-indoor space.

claims.evidence: The watermark appears on all photos but does not prove the seller's ownership or the panel's origin.

risks.risk: The panel may be a low-quality or counterfeit unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label on the back of the panel.

risks.risk: The panel may be used or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter test of the open-circuit voltage (Voc) and short-circuit current (Isc) in direct sunlight.

risks.risk: The panel may be missing the mounting hardware or cables.
risks.proof: A photo of the complete kit including all mounting brackets and cables.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's label on the back of the panel.
Video of a multimeter test showing the panel's output in sunlight.
Photo of the mounting hardware and cables included in the sale.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
